definitions.gloss: shipping label; delivery slip; waybill; invoice
definitions.explanation: A document or label attached to a package that contains shipping information such as sender, recipient, address, and contents. Also refers to a commercial invoice accompanying shipped goods.

examples.japanese: {送|おく}り{状|じょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write the address on the shipping label.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{送|おく}り{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}って→貼る：10447_haru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please attach the shipping label to the package.

examples.japanese: {送|おく}り{状|じょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should keep the copy of the shipping label until the package arrives.

notes:
Compound of {送|おく}り (sending) + ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (document, letter). Refers to the paper slip or label used when sending packages through delivery services.

USAGE:
In Japan, when sending packages via ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧ (parcel delivery services like ヤマト{運輸|うんゆ} or {佐川急便|さがわきゅうびん}), you fill out a {送|おく}り{状|じょう} with sender and recipient information. The slip typically comes in multiple carbon copies — one stays with the sender as a receipt (⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧). In business contexts, it can also mean a commercial invoice or packing slip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送|おく}り{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ — to fill out a shipping label
- {送|おく}り{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧ — to attach a shipping label
- {送|おく}り{状|じょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧ — copy of the shipping slip
- ⟦{着払|ちゃくばら}い→着払い：07950_chakubarai⟧{送|おく}り{状|じょう} — cash-on-delivery shipping label

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝票|でんぴょう}→伝票：07487_denpyou⟧ — slip, voucher (broader, includes sales slips and receipts)
- ⟦{納品書|のうひんしょ}→納品書：06594_nouhinsho⟧ — delivery note, packing slip (business document listing items delivered)
- ⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧ — invoice, bill (for requesting payment)
